payload.reason: The evidence provides specific evaluation criteria and metrics used for evaluating the generated text, including the use of gold standard event selection and various automatic evaluation metrics.

claims.text: The evaluation includes comparing generated event descriptions to existing reference text using gold standard event selection.
Word Error Rate (WER) is used as a metric, defined as the number of insertions, substitutions, and deletions divided by the total length of the reference in tokens.
The edit distance between the generated text and its corrected variant is also used to measure the effort needed to correct the output.
